auditor_scope: Read-only audit of the existing stereo-r01 reference, local Tripo result records and mesh derivatives. No Tripo calls or modifications to the source staging were made.

frozen_build_snapshot.note: The source staging is concurrently authored and its outer-regularized.glb subsequently changed. The mesh statistics below describe the audited hash, preserved in this frozen build snapshot, not any later file at the external staging path. source/build.py adds a separately declared smoothing/shelling derivative; see assembly-manifest.surface_derivation and independent-audit.source_hashes for the actual audited assembly.

source_reference.selected_form: Twin visible lenses, continuous sculptural body and left grip. Not the earlier spiral/pinhole design.

cost_evidence_limit: This is the sum of two unique completed task records, not a fresh account-balance or billing API reconciliation. The repeated chain record was not counted twice.

transform.interpretation: The mm mesh agrees with the declared rotation, uniform scaling and translation to floating-point export precision. Vertex count changes are consistent with geometry-only welding of attribute seams.

mesh_audit_method.topology: Unique-edge usage counts, winding consistency, watertightness and split components. Geometry-only welding of raw UV/normal seams was also checked separately.
mesh_audit_method.distance: Bidirectional nearest-vertex checks where explicitly reported; not a certified surface Hausdorff measurement.
mesh_audit_method.limits: No self-intersection certification, print slicing, physical fit or optical test was performed. Signed volume of a nonmanifold mesh is descriptive only.

meshes.note: The as-stored 50068 boundary edges and 237 components include UV/normal attribute seams and must not be interpreted as 237 independent mechanical pieces.
Segmentation retains the same face count and vertex positions within floating-point precision. This does not establish closed or mechanically useful manufacturing parts.
The repaired filename does not indicate successful manifold repair. Boundary edges were removed, but nonmanifold edges increased. Do not treat this as a verified closed printable solid.

meshes.method: Ray parity voxel volume, one closing iteration at 0.4 mm pitch, fill enclosed voids, retain largest connected volume, extract isosurface, simplify with 0.08 mm tolerance.
meshes.note: This is a watertight manufacturing derivative, not the unchanged original master. Face count drops and envelope dimensions change. Internal void filling is an intentional geometry change recorded in the existing regularization report.

conclusions: The recovered current sketch and staged Tripo reference are byte-identical.
Both existing Tripo task records report success, totaling 80 credits across two unique tasks.
The declared master transformation is reproducible; the 140 mm width remains a design assumption.
The mm reference and nominally repaired reference are still nonmanifold and cannot be described as verified printable solids.
The regularized outer is a closed, consistently wound single component, but is an explicitly altered derivative.
The manufacture-ready assembly still requires its own wall, interference, retention, fit-coupon and print checks.
